rdfs_comment_en: A list (concatenated and separated) of taxa reported absent during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Absences can be reported at any taxonomic level. This term refers to the list of taxa within an eco:targetTaxonomicScope that were not detected in an eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

rdfs_comment_en: The reported maximum number of dwc:Occurrences matching an eco:SurveyTarget.

label_es: Son taxones no objetivos completamente reportados
label_fr: Les Taxons non Ciblés sont-ils Entièrement Répertoriés
rdfs_comment_en: Every dwc:Occurrence that was outside of the target taxonomic scope (the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope) and detected during an eco:Survey, and that was detectable using the given protocol (given in eco:protocolDescriptions and dwc:samplingProtocol), was reported.
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to inform a user of the data whether there were non-target taxa that were detected, but left unreported. This term is only relevant if an eco:Survey used restricted search or open search methods and if a target taxonomic scope is declared. Taxonomic scope is based on the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope. Within eco:Surveys that used either a restricted search or an open search method and declared a taxonomic scope, if all dwc:Occurrences that are not included within the target taxonomic scope and that were detected during an eco:Survey were reported, the value of this term should be 'true', otherwise the value of this term should be ‘false'. Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

label_fr: Types de Sources de la Compilation

rdfs_comment_ru: Утверждение, определяющее, получены ли отчётные данные непосредственно в ходе событий (мероприятий) по учету, или являются вспомогательными данными, скомпилированных из других источников, или комбинацией обоих подходов.

dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je používat pro dwc:degreeOfEstablishment řetězce řízených hodnot z řízeného slovníku (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/). Podrobnosti naleznete na https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je oddělit více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který umožňuje jako hodnotu pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.

dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée consiste à utiliser les chaînes de caractères du vocabulaire contrôlé correspondant (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) pour dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. Pour plus de détails, voir https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. La pratique optimale recommandée est de séparer les valeurs d'une liste par une barre verticale ( | ). Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемые строковые значения из контроллируемого словаря (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) для параметра dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. dcterms_description_es: Este término se define según dwc:lifeStage (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/lifeStage). In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all the taxonomic groups explicitly excluded from the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

label_fr: Unité de Surface du Champ d'Application Géospatial
rdfs_comment_en: The units associated with eco:geospatialScopeAreaValue.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. For units containing exponents, use characters from the Unicode Latin-1 Supplement character set (hex 00B2 for squared and 00B3 for cubed). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je používat řízený slovník. Pro jednotky obsahující exponenty používejte znaky z doplňkové znakové sady Unicode Latin-1 (hex 00B2 pro čtverec a 00B3 pro kostku). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který umožňuje jako hodnotu pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: Se recomienda usar un vocabulario controlado. Para unidades con exponentes, utilice caracteres del conjunto de caracteres Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hexadecimal 00B2 para el cuadrado y 00B3 para el cubo). Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri: que solo permite un IRI como valor, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée est d'utiliser un vocabulaire contrôlé. Pour les unités contenant des exposants, utilisez les caractères du jeu de caractères Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hex 00B2 pour la mise au carré et 00B3 pour la mise au cube). Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемый словарь. Для единиц измерения, содержащих показатели степени, используйте символы из набора символов Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hex 00B2 для квадрата и 00B3 для куба). Данный термин имеет эквивалент в пространстве имён ecoiri:, который допускает только IRI в качестве значения, тогда как данный термин допускает любое строковое значение.

label_fr: Valeur de Surface du Champ d'Application Géospatial
rdfs_comment_en: The numeric value for the total area of the geospatial scope of an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Geospatial scope refers to the place described by a dcterms:Location. This area is always greater than or equal to the eco:totalAreaSampledValue because it reflects the targeted location for which an inventory is intended and informs the sampling design. An eco:geospatialScopeAreaValue must have a corresponding eco:geospatialScopeAreaUnit.

rdfs_comment_en: One or more dwc:MaterialEntities were collected during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es seguir el Vocabulario Controlado Booleano de TDWG: http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

rdfs_comment_en: One or more dwc:Occurrences outside the target organismal scopes (eco:targetDegreeOfEstablishmentScope, eco:targetGrowthFormScope, and eco:targetLifeStageScope) were detected and reported for an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to alert users to the presence of non-target organisms (in some disciplines called “bycatch”) reported in an eco:Survey. This term is relevant only if a target organismal scope is declared. Organismal scope is based on the combination of all of the following terms: eco:targetLifeStageScope, eco:excludedLifeStageScope, eco:targetDegreeOfEstablishmentScope, eco:excludedDegreeOfEstablishmentScope, eco:targetGrowthFormScope, and eco:excludedGrowthFormScope. Examination of the organismal scope is needed in order to identify the non-target dwc:Occurrences. It should be possible to confirm the expectations by investigating dwc:Occurrences in an eco:Survey and in its child eco:Surveys (if available). The value of this term should be 'true' if dwc:Occurrences outside the organismal scope(s) as defined at the time of an eco:Survey are reported, otherwise the value of this term should be 'false'. Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

rdfs_comment_en: One or more dwc:Occurrences of taxa outside the target taxonomic scope (the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope) were detected and reported for an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to alert users to the presence of non-target taxa (in some disciplines called “bycatch”) reported in an eco:Survey. This term is relevant only if a target taxonomic scope is declared. Taxonomic scope is based on the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope. Examination of the taxonomic scope is needed in order to identify the non-target taxa. It should be possible to confirm the expectations by investigating the dwc:Occurrences in an eco:Survey and in its child eco:Surveys (if available) or by exploring eco:nonTargetTaxa for an eco:Survey (if populated). The value of this term should be 'true' if dwc:Occurrences of taxa outside the taxonomic scope as defined at the time of an eco:Survey are reported, otherwise the value of this term should be 'false'. Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

rdfs_comment_en: One or more specimen vouchers were collected during an eco:Survey.

dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es seguir el Vocabulario Controlado Booleano de TDWG: http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

dcterms_description_en: This term is only relevant if dwc:organismQuantity is a number. For a detailed explanation, see http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/doc/inclusive/. Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

rdfs_comment_en: Every dwc:Occurrence that was included within the life stage scope, and was detected during an eco:Survey, was reported.
dcterms_description_en: This term is only relevant if an eco:Survey used restricted search or open search methods. If all dwc:Occurrences included within the life stage scope and detected during an eco:Survey were reported, the value should be 'true'. Life stage scope is based on the combination of eco:targetLifeStageScope and eco:excludedLifeStageScope. Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/.

rdfs_comment_en: A list (concatenated and separated) of material sample types collected during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary and separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným postupem je používat řízený slovník a oddělovat více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který jako hodnotu povoluje pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín povoluje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: La práctica recomendada es usar un vocabulario controlado y separar los valores múltiples de una lista con espacio ( | ). Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri:, que solo permite un valor de IRI, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée est d'utiliser un vocabulaire contrôlé et de séparer les valeurs d'une liste par une barre verticale ( | ). Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемый словарь и разделять несколько значений в списке пробелом, вертикальной чертой, пробелом ( | ). У данного термина существует эквивалент в пространстве имён ecoiri:, который допускает только IRI в качестве значения, в то время как данный термин допускает использование любой строки.

rdfs_comment_en: A list (concatenated and separated) of taxa reported during an eco:Survey that are outside of the target taxonomic scope (the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope).
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to allow the full list of taxa that are considered outside of the taxonomic scope and yet were reported in an eco:Survey. This term is relevant only if a target taxonomic scope is declared and eco:hasNonTargetTaxa is ‘true’. Taxonomic scope is based on the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope. Non-target taxa (in some disciplines called “bycatch”) can be reported at any taxonomic level. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

rdfs_comment_en: A detailed description of the methods used during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: This description should be associated with protocols provided in eco:protocolNames. The description may include deviations from a protocol referred to in eco:protocolReferences. Recommended good practice is to provide information about instruments used, calibration, etc. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ).
dcterms_description_cs: Tento popis by měl být spojen s protokoly uvedenými v eco:protocolNames. Popis může obsahovat odchylky od protokolu uvedeného v eco:protocolReferences. Doporučenou dobrou praxí je uvést informace o použitých přístrojích, kalibraci atd. Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je oddělit více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ).
dcterms_description_ru: Данное описание должно относиться к протоколам, указанным в eco:protocolNames. Описание может включать отклонения от протокола, на который ссылается eco:protocolReferences. Рекомендуется указывать информацию об использованных инструментах, калибровке и т.д. Рекомендуется разделение нескольких значений в списке с помощью пробела, вертикальной черты и пробела ( | ).

rdfs_comment_cs: Popis jakýchkoli extrémních povětrnostních podmínek nebo podmínek prostředí, které mohly ovlivnit událost dwc:Event.
rdfs_comment_fr: Description des conditions météorologiques ou environnementales extrêmes qui ont pu affecter le dwc:Event.
rdfs_comment_ru: Описание любых экстремальных погодных или природных условий, которые могли повлиять на dwc:Event.

rdfs_comment_en: A list of weather or climatic conditions present during the dwc:Event.
rdfs_comment_cs: Seznam povětrnostních nebo klimatických podmínek, které se vyskytly během dwc:Event.
rdfs_comment_fr: Liste des conditions météorologiques ou climatiques présentes lors du dwc:Event.
rdfs_comment_ru: Список метеорологических условий, имевших место во время dwc:Event.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a key:value encoding schema for a data interchange format such as JSON.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je použití schématu kódování klíč:hodnota pro formát výměny dat, jako je JSON.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es utilizar un esquema de codificación clave:valor para un formato de intercambio de datos como JSON.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée est d'utiliser un schéma d'encodage clé:valeur pour un format d'échange de données tel que JSON.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуемой практикой является использование схемы кодирования key:value для формата обмена данными, например JSON.

rdfs_comment_en: A description of or reference (publication or URL) to the methods used to determine the sampling effort.
rdfs_comment_cs: Popis nebo odkaz (publikace nebo URL) na metody použité k určení intenzity odběru vzorků.
rdfs_comment_fr: Description ou référence (publication ou URL) des méthodes utilisées pour déterminer le taux d'échantillonnage.
dcterms_description_en: This description should be associated with the values reported in eco:samplingEffortValue and eco:samplingEffortUnit. This is a specialization of eco:protocolDescriptions focused on effort, distinct from the survey method. The effort relates to the intensity of sampling and therefore can assist in interpreting estimates of completeness. This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Tento popis by měl být spojen s hodnotami uvedenými v eco:samplingEffortValue a eco:samplingEffortUnit. Jedná se o specializaci eco:protocolDescriptions zaměřenou na úsilí, odlišné od metody šetření. Úsilí se vztahuje k intenzitě výběru vzorků, a může proto pomoci při interpretaci odhadů úplnosti. Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který umožňuje jako hodnotu pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakýkoli textový řetězec.
dcterms_description_es: Esta descripción debe asociarse con los valores reportados en eco:samplingEffortValue y eco:samplingEffortUnit. Esta es una especialización de eco:protocolDescriptions centrada en el esfuerzo, distinta del método de encuesta. El esfuerzo se relaciona con la intensidad del muestreo y, por lo tanto, puede ayudar a interpretar las estimaciones de completitud. Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri: que solo permite un IRI como valor, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.

rdfs_comment_en: The units associated with an eco:samplingEffortValue.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je používat řízený slovník. Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který jako hodnotu umožňuje pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: Se recomienda usar un vocabulario controlado. Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri: que solo permite un IRI como valor, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée est d'utiliser un vocabulaire contrôlé. Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемый словарь. У данного термина существует эквивалент в пространстве имён ecoiri:, который допускает только IRI в качестве значения, в то время как данный термин допускает использование любой строки.

rdfs_comment_en: The numeric value for the sampling effort expended during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to capture the total sampling effort value. To express details of how the effort was determined use eco:samplingEffortProtocol. For compilations it is recommend not to infer effort. An eco:samplingEffortValue must have a corresponding eco:samplingEffortUnit.
dcterms_description_cs: Tento termín má zachytit celkovou hodnotu úsilí při sběru vzorků. Pro vyjádření podrobností o tom, jak bylo úsilí určeno, použijte eco:samplingEffortProtocol. U kompilací se doporučuje neodvozovat úsilí. Hodnota eco:samplingEffortValue musí mít odpovídající eco:samplingEffortUnit.
dcterms_description_fr: Ce terme sert à exprimer la valeur totale de l'effort d'échantillonnage. Pour détailler la manière dont cet effort a été déterminé, utilisez eco:samplingEffortProtocol. Pour les compilations, il est recommandé de ne pas déduire l'effort d'échantillonnage. Une eco:samplingEffortValue doit avoir une eco:samplingEffortUnit correspondante.

rdfs_comment_en: A person, group, or organization responsible for recording an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: An eco:Survey could be at any level of hierarchy. In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all the organizations or people involved in the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

rdfs_comment_en: Total number of individual sites surveyed during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Site refers to the dcterms:Location at which observations are made or samples/measurements are taken. The site can be at any level of hierarchy.

rdfs_comment_en: Textual description of the hierarchical sampling design.
rdfs_comment_fr: Description textuelle du dispositif hiérarchique d'échantillonnage .
dcterms_description_en: Site refers to the location at which observations are made or samples/measurements are taken. The site can be at any level of hierarchy.
dcterms_description_cs: Místem se rozumí místo, kde se provádějí pozorování nebo odebírají vzorky/měření. Místo může být na jakékoli úrovni hierarchie.
dcterms_description_fr: Le site fait référence à l'endroit où les observations sont faites ou les échantillons/mesures sont prélevés. Le site peut se situer à n'importe quel niveau de la hiérarchie.

rdfs_comment_en: The degrees of establishment of the dwc:Organisms targeted for sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) for dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. For details, refer to https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je používat pro dwc:degreeOfEstablishment řetězce řízených hodnot z řízeného slovníku (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/). Podrobnosti naleznete na https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je oddělit více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který umožňuje jako hodnotu pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: Se recomienda usar cadenas de valores controlados del vocabulario controlado (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) para dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. Para más detalles, consulte https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. Se recomienda separar los valores de una lista con espacio ( | ). Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri:, que solo permite un valor de IRI, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée consiste à utiliser les chaînes de caractères du vocabulaire contrôlé correspondant (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) pour dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. Pour plus de détails, voir https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. La pratique optimale recommandée est de séparer les valeurs d'une liste par une barre verticale ( | ). Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемые строковые значения из контроллируемого словаря (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwcdoe/) для параметра dwc:degreeOfEstablishment. Подробности см. по ссылке: https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084. Рекомендуется разделять несколько значений в списке пробелом, вертикальной чертой, пробелом ( | ). У данного термина существует эквивалент в пространстве имён ecoiri:, который допускает только IRI в качестве значения, в то время как данный термин допускает использование любой строки.

rdfs_comment_cs: Popis nebo odkaz (publikace, URL) na metody použité k určení eco:taxonCompletenessReported.
rdfs_comment_fr: Une description ou une référence (publication, URL) aux méthodes utilisées pour déterminer le contenu de eco:taxonCompletenessReported.
dcterms_description_en: This term allows users to determine how comprehensively an area has been sampled. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Tento termín umožňuje uživatelům určit, jak komplexně byla oblast vzorkována. Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je oddělit více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který jako hodnotu umožňuje pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: Este término permite a los usuarios determinar la exhaustividad del muestreo de un área. Se recomienda separar los valores de una lista con un espacio ( | ). Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri:, que solo permite un IRI como valor, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: Ce terme permet aux utilisateurs de déterminer le degré d'exhaustivité de l'échantillonnage d'une zone. La pratique optimale recommandée est de séparer les différentes valeurs d'une liste par une barre verticale ( | ). Ce terme a un équivalent dans l'ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.

rdfs_comment_en: Statement about whether the taxonomic completeness of an eco:Survey was assessed.
dcterms_description_en: This term is meant to alert users that the inventory was conducted in such a way that all of the target taxa (the combination of eco:targetTaxonomicScope and eco:excludedTaxonomicScope) should have been detectable if they were present during an eco:Survey. This term can provide data users with a qualitative measure of how comprehensively an area has been surveyed, which assists in interpreting species populations, areas of occupancy, inferring species absences, etc. This term is only relevant if an eco:Survey used restricted search or open search methods. If taxonomic completeness was assessed, the methods used or an explanation of the basis of the completeness should be stated in eco:taxonCompletenessProtocols. Recommended best practice is to use controlled value strings from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/doc/tcr/. This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

label_fr: Unité de la Surface Totale Inventoriée
rdfs_comment_en: The units associated with eco:totalAreaSampledValue
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. For units containing exponents, use characters from the Unicode Latin-1 Supplement character set (hex 00B2 for squared and 00B3 for cubed). This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je používat řízený slovník. Pro jednotky obsahující exponenty používejte znaky z doplňkové znakové sady Unicode Latin-1 (hex 00B2 pro čtverec a 00B3 pro kostku). Tento termín má ekvivalent ve jmenném prostoru ecoiri:, který umožňuje jako hodnotu pouze IRI, zatímco tento termín umožňuje jakoukoli řetězcovou literální hodnotu.
dcterms_description_es: Se recomienda usar un vocabulario controlado. Para unidades con exponentes, utilice caracteres del conjunto de caracteres Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hexadecimal 00B2 para el cuadrado y 00B3 para el cubo). Este término tiene un equivalente en el espacio de nombres ecoiri: que solo permite un IRI como valor, mientras que este término permite cualquier valor literal de cadena.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée est d'utiliser un vocabulaire contrôlé. Pour les unités contenant des exposants, utilisez les caractères du jeu de caractères Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hex 00B2 pour la mise au carré et 00B3 pour la mise au cube). Ce terme a un équivalent dans le ecoiri: namespace qui n'autorise qu'un IRI comme valeur, alors que ce terme autorise n'importe quelle valeur sous forme de chaîne de caractères.
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется использовать контролируемый словарь. Для единиц измерения, содержащих показатели степени, используйте символы из набора символов Unicode Latin-1 Supplement (hex 00B2 для квадрата и 00B3 для куба). Данный термин имеет эквивалент в пространстве имён ecoiri:, который допускает только IRI в качестве значения, тогда как данный термин допускает любое строковое значение.

label_fr: Valeur de la Surface Totale Inventoriée
rdfs_comment_en: A numeric value for the total area, volume or distance surveyed during the eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: This value is always less than or equal to the eco:geospatialScopeAreaValue because it reflects the portion of the geospatialScope that was actually sampled. An eco:totalAreaSampledValue must have a corresponding eco:totalAreaSampledUnit.

rdfs_comment_en: Original textual description of the site(s).
dcterms_description_en: Site refers to the dcterms:Location at which observations are made or samples/measurements are taken. The site can be at any level of hierarchy. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ).

rdfs_comment_en: A list (concatenated and separated) of original site names.
rdfs_comment_cs: Seznam (spojený a oddělený) původních názvů lokalit.
rdfs_comment_fr: Une liste (concaténée et séparée) de noms originaux des sites.
dcterms_description_en: Site refers to the dcterms:Location at which observations are made or samples/measurements are taken. The site can be at any level of hierarchy. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ).

rdfs_comment_en: The verbatim original description of an eco:Survey scope.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is first to populate explicit scope terms to the fullest extent possible (e.g., eco:targetTaxonomicScope). It is not recommended to use this term in assessing absence or completeness.
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným osvědčeným postupem je nejprve v co největší míře vyplnit explicitní termíny oboru (např. eco:targetTaxonomicScope). Nedoporučuje se používat tento termín při posuzování absence nebo úplnosti.
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée consiste à remplir d'abord les termes explicites du champ d'application dans toute la mesure du possible (par exemple, eco:targetTaxonomicScope). Il n'est pas recommandé d'utiliser ce terme pour évaluer l'absence ou l'exhaustivité.

rdfs_comment_en: A list (concatenated and separated) of the names or acronyms of the institutions where vouchers collected during an eco:Survey were deposited.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ).
dcterms_description_cs: Doporučeným postupem je oddělit více hodnot v seznamu mezerou svislou čarou mezerou ( | ).
dcterms_description_fr: La pratique optimale recommandée consiste à séparer les différentes valeurs d'une liste par une barre verticale ( | ).
dcterms_description_ru: Рекомендуется разделение нескольких значений в списке с помощью пробела, вертикальной черты и пробела ( | ).

rdfs_comment_en: A dwc:Event intentionally designed to characterize a defined biotic target or domain in such a way that the resulting dwc:Occurrences can be interpreted collectively to support ecological and monitoring inference (such as detectability, abundance, species co-occurence, spatial distribution, or temporal trends), rather than merely documenting individual observations or gathered material.
dcterms_description_en: Many terms from the Humboldt Extension for Ecological Inventories (eco: namespace) are organized in this class, particularly those that help describe and document the sampling process.

rdfs_comment_en: An identifier for an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es utilizar un identificador único a nivel global.

rdfs_comment_en: One or more scopes that describe a target for dwc:Occurrences in an eco:Survey.
rdfs_comment_es: Uno o más ámbitos que describen un objetivo para dwc:Occurrences en un eco:Survey.

rdfs_comment_en: An identifier for an eco:SurveyTarget.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier. Note: values of this term are not meant to be unique within an eco:SurveyTarget. A full eco:SurveyTarget is composed of all records that share the same eco:surveyTargetID.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada consiste en utilizar un identificador único a nivel global. Nota: los valores de este término no tienen por qué ser únicos dentro de un eco:SurveyTarget. Un eco:SurveyTarget completo está compuesto por todos los registros que comparten el mismo eco:surveyTargetID.

rdfs_comment_en: A category that best matches the nature of a scope in an eco:SurveyTarget.
rdfs_comment_es: Una categoría que se ajusta mejor a la naturaleza de un ámbito en un eco:SurveyTarget.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es utilizar un vocabulario controlado. Los términos del espacio de nombres ecoiri: namespace están destinados a utilizarse en RDF con objetos no literales.

rdfs_comment_en: A value to include or exclude in a scope categorized by eco:surveyTargetType.
rdfs_comment_es: Un valor que se debe incluir o excluir en un ámbito categorizado por eco:surveyTargetType.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

rdfs_comment_en: Unit associated with a value in eco:surveyTargetValue.
rdfs_comment_es: Unidad asociada a un valor en eco:surveyTargetValue.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada es utilizar un vocabulario controlado. Los términos del espacio de nombres ecoiri: namespace están destinados a utilizarse en RDF con objetos no literales.

rdfs_comment_en: Whether to include or exclude eco:surveyTargetValue in a scope categorized by eco:surveyTargetType.
rdfs_comment_es: Si incluir o excluir eco:surveyTargetValue en un ámbito categorizado por eco:surveyTargetType.
dcterms_description_en: Combinations of eco:SurveyTarget records of inclusions and exclusions can define complex scopes such as all flying adult Aves except Passeriformes. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary consisting of 'include' and 'exclude' only.
dcterms_description_es: Las combinaciones de registros de inclusión y exclusión de eco:SurveyTarget permiten definir alcances complejos, como por ejemplo todas las aves adultas voladoras a excepción de los paseriformes. La práctica recomendada consiste en utilizar un vocabulario controlado que incluya únicamente los términos 'incluir' y 'excluir'.

label_es: ¿Se ha informado completamente sobre el objetivo del estudio?
rdfs_comment_en: Whether an eco:SurveyTarget can be used to infer absence of detection because all counts of detected dwc:Occurrences matching an eco:SurveyTarget were fully reported.
rdfs_comment_es: Si un eco:SurveyTarget puede utilizarse para inferir la ausencia de detección, dado que todos los recuentos de dwc:Occurrences detectados que correspondían a dicho eco:SurveyTarget fueron notificados en su totalidad.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to follow the TDWG Boolean Controlled Vocabulary http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/. If True (the survey target is fully reported - nothing was left unreported), then this enables inference of absence of detection for everything in that eco:SurveyTarget that is included but that does not appear in the counts (absent counts signify absence of detection).
dcterms_description_es: La mejor práctica recomendada consiste en seguir el vocabulario controlado booleano de TDWG (http://rs.tdwg.org/tag/doc/boolean/). Si el valor es «True» (lo que indica que el objetivo del muestreo se ha notificado en su totalidad, sin omitir nada), esto permite inferir la ausencia de detección de todos los elementos de ese eco:SurveyTarget que están incluidos pero no figuran en los recuentos (la ausencia de recuentos equivale a la ausencia de detección).

rdfs_comment_en: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for sampling.
dcterms_description_en: The sampling eco:Survey could be at any level of hierarchy. In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all the organizations or people involved in the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate multiple values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).

rdfs_comment_en: A spatial category of a sampling location for an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description_en: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the ecoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
